title: Finite conditioned-collar Doob martingale and shell-influence discriminator
question: Can conditioning a finite actual-Q3 history onto an increasing local coordinate collar expose an exact nonnegative Doob shell square function, separating local likelihood from remote influence without invoking a global Renyi or raw-energy norm?

route: Measure the reference Gibbs state and the transformed split-history state in the product coordinate basis.
Form the full likelihood L=q/p, then condition L onto nested oriented collars F_r containing the measured core coordinate.
Use M_r=E_p[L|F_r] and the exact finite orthogonal martingale identity chi2_global=chi2_local+sum_r E_p[(M_r-M_(r-1))^2].
Treat the shell terms as the only quantities that need a phase-conditioned influence or contour estimate; no volume-extensive global divergence is inserted into the target theorem.
new_perspective.qft_bridge: A uniform weighted shell square-function bound would feed the folded two-replica/local-Renyi route and then the existing common-core and OS/KMS interfaces. The present finite package proves only the algebraic decomposition and records its finite profile.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks scalar nonnegativity and the finite martingale bookkeeping skeleton only; coordinate matrices, Gibbs limits, phase influence, common cores and all QFT transfers remain Python/open analysis.

promotion_criteria: Prove a phase-conditioned folded two-replica domination for every actual split prefix and adjoint without volume or history-length loss.
Prove a source-, volume-, cutoff- and shape-uniform weighted shell square-function estimate on one declared Hamiltonian-derived common core.
Control phase-label changes explicitly before using any mixture convexity, then remove the coordinate cutoff and pass all allowed exhaustion shapes.
Only after those analytic inputs, feed the local likelihood bound into common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS and gap gates.
stop_conditions: If the conditioned shell sum grows with every cutoff-scaled weight, retain the exact decomposition but register a route-local uniformity obstruction.
If phase-conditioned influence is not contractive and no contour/polymer replacement applies, restrict the route to the finite algebraic interface.
If a folded positive representation incurs an unavoidable volume-growing sign or normalization factor, move to the registered modular-cocycle square-function fallback.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite actual-Q3 coordinate-likelihood and oriented Doob-shell diagnostic. It proves no phase-conditioned influence theorem, uniform shell bound, folded Keldysh-to-Euclidean domination, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
no_overclaim: The exact finite martingale identity localizes the bookkeeping but does not bound its shell terms uniformly; finite shell profiles are calibration only.
